capabilities: Import exported Pages Markdown files into vault notes with a text-only preview
Verify figure-to-HTML pairings by ID, reference and SHA-256 before moving sources into place
Restore embedded PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images and convert bare latex blocks to display math
Watch a folder and automatically clean up new exports in place
Back up notes before writes and skip identical or conflicting imports
disambiguation: Not a ChatGPT conversation importer; it imports ChatGPT Pages documents whose HTML visualizations were prepared with a companion authoring skill.
extras: Free and open source with no account, API key, payment or network requests from the importer itself; interactive HTML executes only after explicit trust and may make network requests. Documentation lives largely in linked external guides; interface supports English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
problem: ChatGPT Pages exports only carry native image references, so interactive charts, images and formulas arrive in Obsidian as broken references or raw code blocks.

relations.evidence: use the separately installed Polyglot Renderer to render html fences
GPT Pages Importer connects exported Markdown with complete, portable HTML sources

requires.name: ChatGPT Pages with an AI agent running the authoring skill

summary: Importer that turns ChatGPT Pages Markdown exports into Obsidian notes, restoring verified portable HTML charts, embedded images and display math.
